name: VLS-TS Étudiant (Student visa)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires admission to a recognised French higher-education institution, typically via the Campus France procedure for most applicant nationalities.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission and complete the Campus France procedure where applicable.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires demonstrating sufficient financial means, assessed against a reference monthly amount used by Campus France/consulates.
requirements.fix_path: Arrange sufficient funds or a scholarship/funding declaration.

evidence_required.document: Campus France procedure completion (for applicable nationalities)

sources.title: Campus France — official student admission and visa procedure

notes: Work rights: up to 964 hours/year (approximately equivalent to 60% of full-time), a distinctive annual-hours cap rather than the weekly-hours caps used by most other countries in this dataset (UK, Germany, Netherlands all use weekly limits) — worth surfacing as a genuine structural difference. SOURCING CAVEAT flagged honestly: the exact financial reference amount was not confirmed at a specific tier-1 figure during this research pass — Campus France and consulates apply a reference monthly amount for the 'sufficient means' test, but the precise current euro figure needs a follow-up fetch of the specific Campus France financial-guarantee page before this can be considered fully sourced, similar to Portugal's Blue Card salary caveat. This is the direct feeder into fr_aps_job_seeker, closing France's version of the core Journey chain seen across every country in this dataset.
